extDescription.message: Find the videos a page loads, HLS and MP4 included, and play them in one click. V-AX (v-ax.com)

emptyList.message: No videos found in this tab yet. Start the video, or reload the page.

pastePlaceholder.message: Or paste a video URL (m3u8, mp4)

errRefusedDetail.message: The link may have expired, or the site only allows viewing on its own page. Reload the page and open the video from the list again.

errExpiredDetail.message: This site's video links stay valid only briefly. Reload the page, and open the video from the list as soon as it starts playing.

errNotFoundDetail.message: The link may have expired, or the video was removed.

errOfflineDetail.message: Check your connection. The site may also have blocked this request.

errDrmDetail.message: This video may be protected by DRM. This player can't play protected content.

errDecodeDetail.message: Your browser can't decode this video.

errFileDetail.message: The link may have expired, the site may have refused access, or your browser may not support this format. Reload the page and try again.

errUrlDetail.message: Use a video URL that starts with http or https.

errBrowserDetail.message: This browser can't play HLS video.

errRulesDetail.message: The player couldn't set up its protections for this video, so it didn't start. Try again.
